capabilities: Export the current note to a DOCX file
Convert headings, bold, italics, lists, hyperlinks and code blocks to Word formatting
Embed local and web images and handle their formats and dimensions
Generate DOCX files compatible with Microsoft Word
Run on desktop and mobile without extra software
extras: README documents a known issue: exported files may show wrong formatting in Apple Pages or Preview until re-saved with Microsoft Word. A Chinese version of the README is available.
motivation: The author wanted note export to DOCX that runs on all Obsidian-supported platforms without installing additional external tools.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export notes as Word docx files, and existing approaches require external tools that don't run on mobile.

relations.evidence: A powerful library for generating DOCX files in pure JavaScript/TypeScript.
Used for packing and unpacking DOCX files, which are essentially zipped archives.

summary: DOCX exporter that converts notes to Microsoft Word files without external dependencies like Pandoc, on desktop and mobile.
